provenance: Independent hand calculation, before native feature implementation.

matrix_conventions.glcm: Only direction (+1,0); symmetric raw integer counts; both endpoints in mask.
matrix_conventions.glrlm: Only direction (+1,0); rows gray level, columns run length 1,2.
matrix_conventions.glszm: 8-connected; rows gray level, columns zone size 1,2.
matrix_conventions.gldm: 8-neighborhood, alpha=0; dependence includes center; columns size 1,2.
matrix_conventions.ngtdm: 8-neighborhood; rows gray level; columns valid center count, sum absolute differences.

notes: IQR uses linear interpolation: q25=1.25 and q75=2.75.
Kurtosis is population fourth central moment / variance squared, not excess kurtosis.
PyRadiomics entropy adds machine epsilon inside log2; compare with scalar tolerance.
Do not compare a single-direction matrix's features with per-direction-averaged features.
